quality.name: holdout_network
quality.text: Reliable communication requires more than delivering bytes quickly. A sender needs to know whether data reached the receiver, and a receiver needs to identify missing or duplicated messages. Sequence numbers establish an ordering. A timeout can trigger retransmission when an acknowledgement does not arrive. Choosing a very short timeout increases unnecessary retries, while a very long timeout increases the delay after a real failure. Congestion control adjusts the rate at which new traffic enters the network. It responds to changing conditions rather than assuming that every path has a fixed capacity. Measurements from one connection may not describe another connection that follows a different route.

quality.name: holdout_biology
quality.text: Cells use membranes to separate internal processes from the surrounding environment. Proteins embedded in a membrane can move particular molecules across it. Some transport mechanisms use an existing concentration gradient, while others require energy. The behavior of a biological system depends on interactions between many components. Changing one component can alter several processes at once. For that reason, a controlled experiment compares groups that differ in a clearly specified condition. Researchers also need to check whether the measurement itself disturbs the system. Repeating an experiment with another method can reveal an artifact that was invisible in the original procedure.

quality.text: A workshop produces eighteen parts each hour. After five hours it has produced ninety parts. Twelve parts fail inspection, leaving seventy-eight usable parts. If each package holds thirteen parts, the workshop can fill six packages. A second workshop produces twenty-four parts each hour and loses one quarter of its output during inspection. quality.text: Every approved proposal has a named reviewer. Some approved proposals also have a second reviewer. It follows that every proposal with a second reviewer is approved only if an additional rule establishes that relationship. The original statements alone do not establish it.
